description: This file contains a Bash shell script implementing logic for dual boot data check and upgrade management on embedded devices using U-Boot. It handles detection of active partitions, preparation of environment variables, and flashing new firmware images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_datachk
methods.description: Handles the process of upgrading firmware with dual boot data check, including reading and writing environment variables, flashing firmware partitions, and configuring boot order.
